title: The Gambler V: Playing for Keeps
description:
S01 E01
Cardsharp Brady Hawkes searches for his son, who is on the run with outlaws Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.

title: K-19: The Widowmaker
description: The commander (Harrison Ford) of a Russian submarine tries to avert a disaster after a nuclear reactor malfunctions.

title: Shaolin Wooden Men
description: A fighter vows not to speak until he finds the masked man who killed his father.

title: 10th and Wolf
description: An ex-Marine (James Marsden) faces a dilemma after he returns to South Philadelphia and discovers his brother (Brad Renfro) and cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) are entangled in the mob.

title: Judgment Night
description: On their way to a boxing match, four young men take a wrong turn in Chicago and find danger as witnesses to murder.

title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Three investigators (Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Camille Natta) track a cloaked killer who possesses superhuman strength and speed.

title: Wish Upon
description: A teen (Joey King) starts to veer down a dark and dangerous path when an old music box grants her wishes that cause those closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

title: Derailed
description: An undercover operative (Jean-Claude Van Damme) battles terrorists after they seize a train containing biological weapons.

title: Blind Dating
description: After his brother (Eddie Kaye Thomas) sets him up on a series of disastrous dates, a blind man (Chris Pine) falls in love with a nurse (Anjali Jay) from his doctor's office.

title: A Boy and His Dog
description: A young man and his talking canine set out in search of food, shelter and females in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

title: Creepshow 2
description: A vengeful cigar-store Indian, a flesh-eating creature and a hitchhiker who won't stay dead populate a trilogy of terror.

title: Foreign Correspondent
description: A political assassination plunges an American reporter into international intrigue in pre-World War II Europe.

title: Space Truckers
description: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

title: Dog Soldiers
description: A pack of werewolves targets a squad of soldiers (Sean Pertwee, Kevin McKidd) on a training exercise in the Scottish Highlands.

title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
description: A former mental patient (Antonio Banderas) in Spain finds his porno-star dream girl (Victoria Abril) and ties her to her bed.

title: Sharktopus vs. Whalewolf
description: A half-shark, half-octopus battles a hybrid of a killer whale and a wolf.

title: Sabrina the Teen-age Witch
description: The new girl (Melissa Joan Hart) in school gains strange powers which mean track stardom, a popular boyfriend and alienation from those who care about her.

title: Squadron 303: The Battle of Britain
description: Polish fighter pilots defend the United Kingdom during the Battle of Britain.

title: Jeffrey
description: A 30-ish, gay New Yorker (Steven Weber) swears off sex, then falls for an HIV-positive guy (Michael T. Weiss) he meets at the gym.

title: Infernal Affairs III
description: Ten months after the murder of Yan, Ming is set to work on mundane office duties; Yeung reminds Ming of his own suspicious rise to fame.

title: 99 Homes
description: A desperate construction worker (Andrew Garfield) reluctantly accepts a job with the ruthless real-estate broker (Michael Shannon) who evicted him and his family from their home.

title: Rock 'n' Roll High School
description: A teenager (P.J. Soles) and her friends get even with their principal to music by the Ramones.

title: The Last Unicorn
description: An inept magician (Alan Arkin) and a ragged scullery woman (Tammy Grimes) join a unicorn's (Mia Farrow) quest to free her kind from an evil king's ocean prison.

title: Murderball
description: Filmmakers Henry Alex Rubin and Dana Adam Shapiro profile members of paraplegic rugby teams in the United States and Canada.

title: Going All the Way
description: An outgoing Korean War veteran (Ben Affleck) befriends an introspective comrade (Jeremy Davies) in their Indianapolis hometown.

title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
description: 17-year-old Tanya and her three siblings are left in the charge of a crotchety old babysitter who suddenly dies. Posing as an adult, Tanya gets an assistant gig at a fashion company and is thrust into the world of adulthood and parenting.

title: House
description: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

title: Until Death
description: After waking from a coma, a troubled detective (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must save his kidnapped wife from the men he tried to apprehend.

title: Once Upon a Time in China II
description: A martial arts teacher (Jet Li) protects his students and his aunt (Rosamund Kwan) from a mercenary.

title: The Dead Girl
description: In a quintet of stories, the murder of a young runaway connects a group of unrelated women (Toni Collette, Rose Byrne, Mary Beth Hurt).

title: Abduction
description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures.

title: City on Fire
description: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

title: Dragon Fist
description: A kung-fu student avenges the slaying of his master, with help from his master's clan.

title: An Eye for an Eye
description: A San Francisco policeman (Chuck Norris) quits the force to avenge his partner's murder by Asian drug dealers.

title: Quadrophenia
description: A rebellious teen vents his anger with the Mods and the Rockers in 1964 London. Based on the album by the Who.

title: Deadly Outlaw: Rekka
description: A yakuza (Riki Takeuchi) becomes the target of two clans after the murder of his beloved boss.

title: Bullet in the Head
description: Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) try crime in Vietnam and land in a prison camp with U.S. soldiers.

title: Children of the Corn
description: A doctor (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend (Linda Hamilton) see no adults in a Nebraska town run by a crop of teens.

title: Side Effects
description: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

title: Basmati Blues
description: When a young scientist learns she has unwittingly aided a destructive plan against the Indian farmers she was supposedly sent to help, she teams up with a local farmer to save the day.

title: Standing Up, Falling Down
description: A failing stand-up comedian and an alcoholic dermatologist give each other the confidence to face the failures in their lives.

title: The Rebound
description: A newly single woman (Catherine Zeta-Jones) becomes involved with the much-younger man (Justin Bartha) she hired to take care of her children.

title: The Tai Chi Master
description: Two Shaolin Temple pupils (Jet Li, Chin Siu-hou) take different life paths, leading to an ultimate battle between them.
